claim.title: text-danger on bg-danger/10 measured 3.95:1 (below AA) — design system had no danger-ink token

verdict: NOT REFUTED — defect is real and independently reproduced; but the claim's post-fix evidence number (12.29:1) is a PROBE ARTEFACT

checks.name: pre-fix source present in HEAD
checks.detail: git show HEAD:... — 36 occurrences of `text-danger` used as TEXT across 23 .vue files. No `danger-ink` token in HEAD tailwind.config.js (only accent/secondary/tertiary/quaternary/success/warning ink existed). Root-cause claim verified.

checks.name: contrast math (independent recompute)
checks.detail: #E11D48 on bg-danger/10 composited over cream #FFFDF5 = rgb(252,231,228) -> 3.957:1 (claim: 3.95). #E11D48 on cream = 4.612 (claim 4.61); on white = 4.697 (claim 4.70). All match.

checks.name: live reproduction on running stack
checks.detail: Forced error via page.route abort on /leaderboard. Live alert section bg composited = rgb(252,231,228). Injecting text-danger color rgb(225,29,72) over it = 3.96:1 < 4.5. Reproducible.

checks.name: claim's 're-measured 12.29:1' after fix
checks.detail: The audit's own evidence/focused-probe.json records the after-fix element color as rgb(30,41,59) = #1E293B (the inherited --geo-fg), NOT #BE123C. #BE123C max contrast on any light surface is 6.29:1 (white); 12.29 is mathematically impossible for the ink token. 12.29 = #1E293B on rgb(252,231,228) (12.32 computed). So the '12.29' measured the fallback inherited foreground, i.e. the .text-danger-ink class had resolved to nothing at measurement time — the exact silent-no-op failure mode the config comments warn about (audit-v5).

checks.name: is .text-danger-ink actually served on the live dev stack?
checks.detail: Scanning all document.styleSheets on localhost:5173 finds only `.text-danger`; `.text-danger-ink` is absent. A probe div with class text-danger-ink computes color rgb(30,41,59) (inherited), not rgb(190,18,60). --geo-danger-ink:#BE123C IS live (design-system.css served directly), but the Tailwind utility was not regenerated by the dev server (tailwind.config.js change needs restart).

checks.name: is the fix real in the build artifact?
checks.detail: frontend/dist/assets/index-DGagIOqm.css contains `.text-danger-ink{--tw-text-opacity:1;color:rgb(190 18 60 / var(--tw-text-opacity,1))}` -> #BE123C on the tint = 5.29:1 (PASS). So the fix is correct in the production build; only the live dev server under-serves it.

checks.name: severity
checks.detail: Same defect class as F-13-03/04/05 (vivid token used as text), which the audit also rated MEDIUM. #E11D48 passes on plain cream/white (4.61/4.70) so impact is limited to the /10 tinted error/alert panels. Not HIGH; MEDIUM or LOW both defensible, MEDIUM consistent with rubric.

checks.name: line numbers in claim
checks.detail: Leaderboard.vue:23, Decks.vue:38, AdminDashboard.vue:9, AdminSpeakingSubmissions.vue:189, AiGeneratePanel.vue:94 match. DeckDetail.vue claim:16 actual:17; AdminVideoAttempts claim:23 actual:24; AdminVideoLessons claim:83 actual:84. Off-by-one, not material.

conclusion: The claimed defect is REAL: text-danger (#E11D48) on bg-danger/10 composites to rgb(252,231,228) = 3.96:1 < AA, and HEAD had no danger-ink token. NOT REFUTED. However the claim's fix-verification number '12.29:1' is invalid — it measured the inherited foreground #1E293B (class silently unresolved), not the new #BE123C token (which is 5.29:1 on the tint). The live dev server still does not serve .text-danger-ink.
